name: The Insurgents' Linden (Lipa Powstańców)

location.address: Old Cemetery (Cmentarz Stary), section B-1, opposite the Chapel of the Dying Jesus, ul. Wyszyńskiego 42, Radomsko

access: Free; stands in Radomsko's Old Cemetery, open to the public in daylight hours like any Polish cemetery.
transport: In central Radomsko; the Old Cemetery entrance is on ul. Wyszyńskiego, an easy walk from the town centre.
verify_notes: Two independent Wikipedia sources: the tree's own dedicated article and 'Pomniki przyrody w Radomsku' (the city's register list, reproducing the CRFOP/voivode designation). Both agree closely. Origin: planted as three small saplings in 1863 on the grave of three Radomsko insurgents murdered by Russian soldiers on the night of 23-24 January (dedicated article), or 'year of origin 1860' per the register table -- treat as roughly 1860-1863, so about 165 years old today (2026), a documented planting date rather than a growth-rate estimate. The three original stems have long since grown together into what reads as one tree, now reduced to two main branches after storm damage and extensive conservation surgery. Girth: dedicated article gives 540cm, register table gives 533cm at breast height; recorded 533 from the register, both are close enough to be the same measurement campaign. Height 23m (register), crown now reduced to 12x11m after the 2021-2022 works. Natural monument status since 3 July 1998 (Regulation No. 5/98 of the Piotrków Voivode). Alive and recently confirmed: comprehensive conservation work (corrective and health pruning, trunk surgery with a living brace, a reinforced-concrete pylon and steel bindings to stop it falling on the neighbouring chapel) ran 2021-2022 with a formal reopening/inauguration on 12 May 2023 -- strong recent alive evidence. Oldest, thickest and historically most significant tree in Radomsko per the register article; the whole city holds 13 natural monuments, all trees. Worth leading with: three planted for three murdered insurgents, now grown into one trunk standing guard by the cemetery's chapel.
